artifact_lifecycle_matrix.artifact: Repository-owned continuation skill and preflight-result schema

artifact_lifecycle_matrix.freshness: The selected task, packet, profile, and repository snapshot are derived again on every preflight run

artifact_lifecycle_matrix.artifact: Repository-local profile covering the four portable Factory workers
artifact_lifecycle_matrix.producer_or_authority: Vetryn repository policy maintained through reviewed commits
artifact_lifecycle_matrix.freshness: Preflight requires the tracked profile bytes to equal the current commit and binds its digest into the compiled packet
artifact_lifecycle_matrix.integrity: Strict typed profile validation plus committed-byte and packet-digest comparison
artifact_lifecycle_matrix.authenticity: Protected repository history is the policy authority; local or untracked profile edits are rejected
transitions_and_recovery: Profile changes invalidate packet and worker-pack resolution and require recompilation.
A dirty, untracked, symlinked, malformed, or stale profile blocks before any later action.

artifact_lifecycle_matrix.producer_or_authority: Factory immutable source commit selected by the Vetryn profile
artifact_lifecycle_matrix.mutable_owner: Factory maintainers at source and the local installer before verification
artifact_lifecycle_matrix.freshness: The profile pins one immutable pack source and exact manifest digest for every required worker
artifact_lifecycle_matrix.integrity: A repository-owned bootstrap verifies the external manifest pin and verifier digest before invoking installed pack code
artifact_lifecycle_matrix.authenticity: The committed Vetryn profile is the offline trust anchor; installed verifier output alone is never accepted as proof
transitions_and_recovery: Only a complete digest-matching pack set transitions from imported to actionable.
Missing, mixed-version, extra-required, forged, or tampered pack resources block and require reinstall from the pinned source.

artifact_lifecycle_matrix.producer_or_authority: Repository-owned preflight over canonical Git, plan, packet, profile, and skill inputs

artifact_lifecycle_matrix.freshness: Every result names the observed commit and reports that remote freshness was not checked offline
artifact_lifecycle_matrix.integrity: Canonical JSON, repeated derivation, packet digest, and before-after repository snapshots

artifact_lifecycle_matrix.artifact: Canonical M0-11 plan state and compiled task packet
artifact_lifecycle_matrix.producer_or_authority: Reviewed Vetryn plan, ledger, state, and deterministic task compiler

artifact_lifecycle_matrix.integrity: Repository schemas, source digests, deterministic compilation, and lifecycle candidate binding

authorization_boundary_trace.authority: AGENTS.md, WORKFLOW.md, canonical plan contracts, and the compiled M0-11 packet

authorization_boundary_trace.denied_behavior: Emit a typed blocker and preserve the repository byte-for-byte

authorization_boundary_trace.authority: M0-11 allowed paths and committed artifact contracts
authorization_boundary_trace.input: Continuation skill, schema, tests, profile, policy documentation, and semantic-risk artifacts
authorization_boundary_trace.denied_behavior: Reject files outside packet scope and never persist prompts, credentials, grants, or raw runtime output

authorization_boundary_trace.authority: Canonical main plan and exact compiled M0-11 packet
authorization_boundary_trace.input: Objective, paths, capabilities, gates, reviews, retry budget, and acceptance items
authorization_boundary_trace.denied_behavior: Stop on plan drift, ambiguous task selection, missing dependencies, or exhausted attempts

authorization_boundary_trace.authority: Current user grant intersected with the compiled packet; the skill and preflight grant nothing
authorization_boundary_trace.input: Task-scoped implementation on a non-protected branch
authorization_boundary_trace.denied_behavior: Do not create a branch or edit files without a current exact-task grant; never mutate during preflight

authorization_boundary_trace.authority: Packet-declared deterministic local validation commands and repository workflow
authorization_boundary_trace.input: Shell-free preflight adapters and task-scoped local checks
authorization_boundary_trace.denied_behavior: Reject undeclared, provider-capable, credentialed, destructive, or shell-interpreted commands

authorization_boundary_trace.authority: Later authenticated listed-maintainer grant plus Factory commit-push protected lifecycle
authorization_boundary_trace.input: Fetch, push, pull-request, review, promotion, merge, and post-merge actions
authorization_boundary_trace.denied_behavior: Read-only preflight performs no network or GitHub action; later stages stop unless authority and non-waivable gates pass

authorization_boundary_trace.authority: GitHub protected-branch checks and post-merge monitoring observed by the delivery worker
authorization_boundary_trace.input: Latest-head CI, review state, merge result, and canonical default-branch status
authorization_boundary_trace.denied_behavior: Preflight neither fabricates nor changes external status and cannot declare delivery complete

normative_adversarial_matrix.invariant: Preflight is read-only across HEAD, branch, refs, index, worktree including ignored files, Git config, remotes, and canonical task inputs.
normative_adversarial_matrix.positive: Two runs in an unchanged arbitrary checkout produce byte-identical ready output and identical snapshots.
normative_adversarial_matrix.missing: A missing Git object, plan input, profile, adapter, command, or skill produces a blocker before execution continues.
normative_adversarial_matrix.stale: A local default ref mismatch, stale packet digest, or changed profile blocks.
normative_adversarial_matrix.contradictory: Conflicting branch, task-state, candidate, or snapshot relationships block rather than choosing a winner.
normative_adversarial_matrix.tampered: Tracked, untracked, ignored, symlink, mode, index, ref, config, and adapter-induced changes are detected and reported; Git replacement refs are rejected before canonical reads.
normative_adversarial_matrix.transition_or_recovery: The preflight never auto-repairs; the operator restores canonical state and reruns from the start.
normative_adversarial_matrix.concurrency: Concurrent drift between repeated derivations or before-after snapshots blocks the result.

normative_adversarial_matrix.invariant: Selection chooses exactly one active task, otherwise one next-legal task, with no baked task identifier; resume is limited to canonical in-progress state with no frozen candidate.
normative_adversarial_matrix.positive: One candidate-null in-progress task on a clean in-scope descendant wins over future legal work, or one next-legal task is compiled dynamically.
normative_adversarial_matrix.missing: Zero active and zero next-legal tasks returns no_legal_task.
normative_adversarial_matrix.stale: State and packet disagreement or a source-digest change blocks.
normative_adversarial_matrix.contradictory: Multiple active tasks, multiple next-legal tasks, conflicting active and packet state, candidate-bound work, or a later lifecycle state returns a typed blocker.
normative_adversarial_matrix.tampered: An adapter returning a mismatched task or malformed JSON is rejected.
normative_adversarial_matrix.transition_or_recovery: Canonical planning or promotion tooling repairs the state; the continuation skill never edits the plan.
normative_adversarial_matrix.concurrency: Two derivations that select or compile different values block as concurrent drift.

normative_adversarial_matrix.invariant: Installed Factory workers are usable only when authenticated by the committed repository profile and complete manifest closure before installed code executes.
normative_adversarial_matrix.positive: All required workers share the pinned set version and source and every manifest, verifier, helper, schema, and reference digest matches.
normative_adversarial_matrix.missing: Any missing worker, verifier, manifest, helper, schema, profile field, or standard reference blocks.
normative_adversarial_matrix.stale: An old source commit, mixed pack set, or stale manifest pin blocks.
normative_adversarial_matrix.contradictory: Profile, manifest, and installed resource claims that disagree block without precedence guessing.
normative_adversarial_matrix.tampered: A forged verifier that prints success, a rewritten manifest, path traversal, symlink, or dirty profile is rejected before installed code runs.
normative_adversarial_matrix.transition_or_recovery: Reinstall the complete set from the immutable source and update pins only through a reviewed repository change.
normative_adversarial_matrix.concurrency: Pack or profile bytes changing during verification invalidate the snapshot and block.

normative_adversarial_matrix.invariant: The stable continuation procedure is separate from current mutation and delivery authority.
normative_adversarial_matrix.positive: After ready preflight, an authenticated active maintainer explicitly grants the selected task, packet, and action set for the current run.
normative_adversarial_matrix.missing: No grant, no authenticated principal, no current repository role, or no roster membership stops before mutation.
normative_adversarial_matrix.stale: Revoked membership, changed packet, changed task, or expired run context invalidates a prior grant.
normative_adversarial_matrix.contradictory: Denial, packet capability ceilings, and non-waivable rules override broader claimed permission.
normative_adversarial_matrix.tampered: Chat text, ambient credentials, CODEOWNERS, roster membership, skill invocation, and self-asserted usernames are not accepted as authentication.
normative_adversarial_matrix.transition_or_recovery: Obtain a new exact current-run grant after re-authentication and rerun preflight when repository state changed.
normative_adversarial_matrix.concurrency: Authority is rechecked at each external-effect boundary and cannot transfer between parallel tasks.

normative_adversarial_matrix.invariant: Execution is portable and never depends on an absolute machine path, sibling Factory checkout, ambient credentials, or live provider access.
normative_adversarial_matrix.positive: A fresh arbitrary-path clone with only pinned installed packs passes offline preflight.
normative_adversarial_matrix.missing: No sibling checkout is tolerated; a missing installed pack yields a typed installation blocker.
normative_adversarial_matrix.stale: Machine-local cached state cannot override committed profile or packet inputs.
normative_adversarial_matrix.contradictory: Environment variables and committed policy conflicts resolve to the stricter committed policy.
normative_adversarial_matrix.tampered: Secret-bearing environment values and remote URLs are neither consumed nor emitted.
normative_adversarial_matrix.transition_or_recovery: Install the pinned pack set, restore committed inputs, and rerun without changing repository policy locally.
normative_adversarial_matrix.concurrency: Parallel checkouts resolve their own repository roots and cannot share mutable repository state.

normative_adversarial_matrix.invariant: Promotion and delivery remain ordered, candidate-bound, protected, and never push directly to main or automatically merge product changes.
normative_adversarial_matrix.positive: Validation, structured review, maintainer promotion, protected PR delivery, latest-head checks, merge, and post-merge monitoring occur in order.
normative_adversarial_matrix.missing: Missing evidence, unresolved P0/P1, failed commands, or missing authority blocks promotion and delivery.
normative_adversarial_matrix.stale: Candidate changes invalidate validation, review, promotion, and shipping evidence.
normative_adversarial_matrix.contradictory: A green report cannot override a failing required check or non-waivable policy.
normative_adversarial_matrix.tampered: Unbound, cross-task, cross-candidate, or fabricated lifecycle evidence is rejected.
normative_adversarial_matrix.transition_or_recovery: Repair the exact candidate, rerun invalidated gates, and use the protected PR workflow.
normative_adversarial_matrix.concurrency: Latest-head review and CI must bind to the same candidate before merge.

attack_cases: Modify tracked, ignored, symlink, mode, index, ref, config, profile, manifest, verifier, helper, schema, packet, or plan bytes.
Forge verifier success, claim a username or role, rewrite a local profile pin, or rely on ambient credentials.
Use stale local default refs, old task packets, changed source digests, revoked roles, or prior-run authority.
Remove one required worker, manifest entry, helper, schema, profile field, snapshot category, gate, review, or acceptance item.
Run mutation before preflight, promotion before validation or review, delivery before promotion, or merge before latest-head gates.
Restore an older profile, pack-set pin, packet, candidate, review, CI result, or maintainer grant after newer canonical state exists.

residual_risks: Offline preflight can prove consistency with local remote-tracking refs but cannot prove server freshness; an authorized fetch and second preflight are required before branching or delivery.
Read-only preflight cannot authenticate the invoking human; a separate runtime gate must verify current maintainer identity, repository role, exact-task grant, and action scope before mutation.

Preflight is not a defense against a malicious process with the same OS account that can rewrite and restore repository adapter or dependency bytes during execution; run it only on a trusted local host. HEAD ownership, shell-free allowlisted adapters, repeated derivation, and full before-after snapshots bound accidental and persistent drift.
Operators must install the exact externally pinned worker-pack set before offline continuation; preflight rejects missing, partial, extra, or digest-mismatched installed bytes.
